payload.title: Close ClayCode BASE critical path starting with strict WP02 canonical IR receipt
payload.work_clay: Re-read newest main. Preserve CC-WP-01 PASS and all non-PASS gates. Immediate discriminator: run tools/claycode_base_frontend_validation.py and tools/claycode_base_canonical_ir_validation.py on a real repository checkout using default strict mode, current D_LALR_GRAMMAR_REPAIR_CANDIDATE_V5.lark, CLAYCODE_G9_FUSION_SPEC_V3.clay and DIALECT_REGISTRY_V3.clay. Install/enable the normal strict-Lark dependency set on the Ubuntu developer host if needed; do not use --proxy-nonstrict for acceptance. Persist exact grammar/source/tool hashes, strict construction result, deterministic parse result, canonical JSON IR byte-roundtrip, repeat-parse identity, presentation-equivalence and mutation-discrimination receipt. Then compare the BASE frontend surface against the real frozen FRANK ClayCode subsystem(s) selected for WP13 and record syntax/semantic gaps as executable counterexamples rather than silently widening the language. Only after WP02 evidence is complete move to WP03 typed IR/types. Preserve model-output != execution-authority and Ubuntu-only Frank v0.1 scope.
payload.reason_clay: ChatGPT authored and proxy-tested a deterministic canonical syntax-IR validator at commit 655747796c44f3ec4ab6fbca279aae6f29830c0d. Hosted proxy passed canonical serialize/deserialize/re-serialize identity, repeat parse identity, one presentation-equivalence case and 8/8 mutation discriminators, but strict=True could not run because interegular is absent and the proxy used only a minimal grammar fixture. Therefore the highest-information next action is one strict current-corpus repository/Ubuntu receipt, not further semantic redesign. FRANK's current canonical goal independently reports compiler/local materialization as open, so closing this receipt directly unblocks the FRANK v0.1 path.
payload.completion_clay: Immediate revision is complete when (1) strict LALR current V5 construction succeeds or yields an exact reproducible counterexample; (2) full current G9 V3 + Dialect V3 sources parse; (3) canonical syntax-IR serialize->deserialize->serialize is byte-identical and repeated parse is byte-identical; (4) ignored presentation equivalence remains hash-stable; (5) all listed operator/literal/order/relation mutations remain hash-distinguishable; (6) exact Ubuntu/repository receipt is committed; (7) no CC-WP-02 PASS is issued unless all existing WP02 acceptance evidence including canonicalization is satisfied; (8) the next production step is WP03 typed IR/types or a concrete parser counterexample. The parent BASE work remains incomplete until CC-WP-01..14 all satisfy their original acceptance contract.
payload.executor_policy: Immediate local-build priority: prefer verified Claude Code/local Ubuntu build organ with repository checkout. ChatGPT remains research/synthesis/adjudication organ. Do not duplicate already-running parser edits; re-read newest main before edits and consume existing V5/frontend work. Proxy/container success never becomes Ubuntu PASS. No paid training/API work and no Android/mobile/edge portability for Frank v0.1.
invalidators: BASE acceptance contract is superseded by explicit project-owner directive
Ubuntu developer system ceases to be Frank v0.1 target host
